$comment: Source of truth for docs/COMPARISON.md (run scripts/gen-comparison.py) and for the site's copy. Stock states: Y the vendor tool has it, N it does not, X the platform has no such thing. openrcs states: F full, P partial, M missing, B beyond stock, X not applicable.
subject: openrcs
intro: Where openrcs stands against the software Analog Way ships for each processor family — the RCS² for the Midra series, the Web RCS for LiveCore, LivePremier and Midra 4K. Every row is a feature; the stock column is the vendor's inventory and the openrcs column is the verdict against it.
